slides.headline: The AI that makes game characters feel alive
Unreal Agent AI launched today
slides.body: The tool lets game creators build characters that talk and act like real people, no coding needed.

slides.headline: Games feel more lifelike now
slides.body: Characters can react to your choices with natural speech and emotions, making play feel like a movie.

slides.headline: Fake characters could mislead
slides.body: Characters powered by AI might be used in videos that look real but are scripted to deceive viewers.

slides.headline: Enjoy, but stay aware
slides.body: Ask yourself if a game character’s advice could be made by AI, not from a human.

slides.headline: Follow for AI news
slides.body: Get simple explanations of AI that affect your daily life, no tech jargon.
